sentences.text: Captain Lara and her crew were on a mission.
They were exploring a distant planet.
One day, they found a strange object.
It was buried in the ground.
The object was shiny and blue.
Each crew member touched the object.
She could not lift rocks anymore.
"We need to get rid of this," said Lara.
She tried to bury the object again.
The object was stuck to her hand.
They did not know what to do.
They went back to their spaceship.
But the spaceship did not work.
The object was draining its power.
"We need to find a way out," said Sam.
He used his power to see through the walls.
They found an old alien ship.
It looked like it could fly.
"Let's try to use this ship," said Mia.
It was powered by the object.
But the ship had a mind of its own.
The crew could not control it.
They did not know where they were going.
"We need to work together," said Lara.
They used their powers to control the ship.
It was hard, but they did it.
The ship flew back to Earth.
When they landed, they buried the object deep in the ground.
They did not want anyone to find it.
They knew the powers were dangerous.
They were happy to be home.
They learned that some things are better left alone.
